opportunities.title: Small grants

amount.raw: generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000; will only exceptionally exceed £6,000; travel up to £2,000 per person (13 days or less) or £2,500 per person (14 days+); PhD fieldwork visits up to £5,000; Japan office up to ¥300,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. Applications not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects (UK office may consider individuals with proof of organisational support; grant payments cannot be made to personal bank accounts). Projects originating in the UK submitted to UK office, in Japan to Japan office.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding to enable UK-Japan projects that deepen mutual understanding, encourage exchange of ideas or expertise, or develop lasting collaboration between the two nations. Supports festivals, workshops, performances, exchanges, collaborative projects, Japanese language teaching, academic research and visits.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in medicine and health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year; continuing projects lasting up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, total limit £30,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK. Applicants should normally show an existing research record, but consideration also given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields. Preference to those not previously involved in UK-Japan collaboration; early-career applicants particularly welcomed. Must involve partners in both the UK and Japan and be supported by reputable referees not based at the same institution as either project partner.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Grants may be used for travel expenses or to contribute to other costs including conference and publication costs.
